thread:
morgan: Quick consolidation after the postmortem — listing follow-ups for rollout safety. I want owners and short targets so we can close these in the postmortem.

lee: Thanks. To keep this distinct from prior threads: we should add per-tenant circuit-breakers and a feature-flag policy DSL so product can express blast-radius limits declaratively.

morgan: Agreed. Recurring pattern summary: ramped canary -> shard skew -> downstream connection exhaustion -> error surge. Two unusual observations this time: geo-skew (EU cluster got much higher fraction) and low entropy in routing seeds.

anya: I'll own randomized routing + sampling QC and the canary skew dashboard. Target: 2025-03-22. Plan: implement randomized bucket seed and add a nightly job that computes per-shard entropy and alerts if entropy < 0.6.

lee: I'll take the feature-flag policy DSL + per-tenant circuit-breaker. Deliverable: DSL draft + PoC enforcement in rollout controller. Target: 2025-04-01. DSL will allow rules like: max_active_users_per_tenant, max_shard_concurrency, burst_protection_seconds.

morgan: I'll own emergency rollback semantics and the integration/fleet-sim test harness. Target: 2025-03-28. We'll simulate geo skew + DB backpressure in the fleet simulator to validate rollback/scale-down ordering.

ops-bot: deploy: canary run 2025-02-28T08:12Z — shards=5, concurrency=160, sample_rate=0.04, region=eu-west

morgan: Draft rollback rule (proposal):
```
# emergency rollback policy (draft):
if (p95_latency > 1.6s OR aggregate_5xx_ratio >= 0.7%) for 120s:
  step1: reduce_concurrency_by(50%) for 30s
  step2: if metrics still > threshold -> rollback_to(previous_revision)
  notify: oncall + affected-tenants list
```
Also: require per-rollout "blast_radius_policy" in config; if omitted default to conservative caps.

anya: For sampling QC I'll add a metric `canary_shard_entropy` and an alert with severity=page if entropy drops >0.4 and 5xxs increase. Also adding CI sim that runs fleet-sim scenarios on PRs touching rollout controller.

lee: The DSL will also expose a per-tenant circuit-breaker that can temporarily throttle a tenant before a global rollback. That reduces customer impact. Need product/legal input for auto-throttle in contracts.

integrations-bot: tracker: created task ROLLOUT-SAFE-9001 and scheduled recurring triage Tuesdays 09:00 PT

morgan: Timeline recap: routing + QC (anya) 2025-03-22, rollback harness + fleet-sim (morgan) 2025-03-28, policy DSL + circuit-breaker PoC (lee) 2025-04-01. I will create GH board `rollout-policy-and-safety` and require every item to have a ticket and review.

lee: One design question: prefer auto-throttle per-tenant first or global rollback first? My vote: try tenant throttle -> if majority of shards still impacted within 30s escalate to rollback. We'll prototype ordering in PoC.

anya: Noted. I'll ensure telemetry surfaces per-tenant error rates so throttle decision can be automated.

morgan: Ok if no objections I'll mark these action items on the postmortem and close the thread.

lee: No objections.

anya: Ack.

ops-bot: tracker: scheduled first triage 2025-03-04 09:00 PT.

morgan: Closing thread 44d — will ping when board is live and post links to PRs.
